messages:
maria: Quick check-in for next-week announcement. We need final public changelog URL, canonical docs link, a one-line benchmark blurb for hero copy, locked webinar CTA, and the canary start window so email timing is accurate. @aj @noah @sara

aj: Changelog is in final review. Ill publish the public page by EOD today and drop the link here.

noah: Docs content is merged to main but requires the redirect flip. Proposed canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/releases/2026-07. Ops, can you schedule the redirect?

ops-lead: Yes. We can flip the redirect at 08:30 PT on release day and monitor for 20 minutes. Will post status updates. Rollout plan: short canary then ramp.

sara: CTA options for the email hero: "See the performance story + register for our 7/22 webinar" or "Join our 7/22 webinar to see the performance gains". Prefer the second — concise and action-oriented. Need final CTA by 15:00 PT to lock the email builder.

maria: Locking CTA #2. Benchmark blurb needs to be short, non-jargon, and defensible. Draft suggestion: "Up to 3x faster p95 with sizable cost reductions on common chat workloads." Thoughts?
	im: Keep it slightly more conservative for press: "Up to 2.5x faster p95 and meaningful cost savings on typical conversational workloads." We'll include the benchmark artifact link in the changelog for technical readers.

aj: Publishing changelog now: https://redwood.inference/changelog/2026-07-release. It's live but still has a short appendix with test details that I'll finalize tomorrow.

noah: I'll add a small note at the top of the docs about the canary and expected behavior during the announcement window so customers know what to expect.

ops-lead: Canary timing proposal: start 08:40 PT at 10% for 15 minutes, then 30% for 20 minutes, full at 09:15 PT. Rollback triggers: p95 > 300ms or error rate > 1% sustained for 3 minutes. I'll orchestrate and post status.

maria: Marketing will schedule the announcement email at 09:30 PT if canary is green by 09:20. Social posts go live at 09:45. Can we confirm well have links and CTA locked by 18:00 today?

aj: Confirmed. Changelog link is live and final enough for marketing.

noah: Docs redirect scheduled; canonical link will be live per ops timing.

sara: I'll drop the final email subject, hero copy, CTA, and 1-line social blurb here by 14:30 PT for a quick review. Proposed subject: "Redwood Inference: faster, cheaper LLM serving".

ops-lead: deploy-bot scheduled jobs: docs-redirect at 08:30 PT, canary rollout at 08:40 PT. Monitoring hooks: perf-alerts, error-rate, rollout-audit. Will post results to this thread.

maria: Great — last ask: include UTM for all links: utm_campaign=july_release&utm_source=email&utm_medium=announce. Also set landing page path for lead routing: /r/july_release. Sales wants a Segment event name: "release_july_signup" and sample payload.

noah: Sample Segment payload (for reference): {"event":"release_july_signup","source":"announce_email","campaign":"july_release"} — will paste as code in docs.

maria: Thanks all. If anything changes, please update this thread. We'll reconvene at 14:30 for the final copy review. :rocket:
